index.name: RONI
index.episode_rule: at least 5 consecutive overlapping 3-month seasons at or beyond ±0.5 °C
index.strength_rule: by |peak_anom_c|: weak 0.5–0.9, moderate 1.0–1.4, strong 1.5–1.9, very strong ≥ 2.0

also_traditional_oni.note: RONI is NOAA's operational index since 2026; ONI shown for reference
